inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if precision-biology customer exposure is immaterial, automation does not improve customer economics, or revenue remains non-repeatable while burn and dilution absorb the benefit.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Ginkgo's automated laboratories, biological data and cell-engineering workflows could reduce experiment cost and cycle time for precision-biology customers if adoption becomes repeatable revenue.

objective: Review whether Ginkgo Bioworks has a material causal relationship to precision biology and healthcare automation using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.
